mapper.sql: SELECT order_id, doctor_id, schedule_id, status, occupied_at, expires_at, released_at FROM consult_doctor_occupancy
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consult_doctor_occupancy (order_id, doctor_id, schedule_id, status, occupied_at, expires_at, released_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{doctorId}, #{scheduleId}, #{status}, #{occupiedAt}, #{expiresAt}, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE consult_doctor_occupancy SET status = #{reason}, released_at = #{releasedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE consult_doctor_occupancy SET expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
